brief: A balcony bed with a pipe run feeding water, two soil-filled bins and a drawer underneath for seed packets.

requirements.evidence: 3 bases level0 (2x half-s, 1x full) + 3 bases level1, 2 bins on level1
run:run-1 at level1 feeding across bed
bin:1,-1,1~hex-bin-full + bin:1,0,1~hex-bin-half-s-full, both fillSoil + planted (prop:1, prop:2), no prop warnings
drawer:0#0,0#cut + drawer:0#1,0#cut under level0 half-s bases; no seed-packet prop exists in catalog (searches for packet/envelope/box returned none), so drawer is empty

finish.summary: Two-storey bed: lower storey holds 2 drawers for seed storage, upper storey has pipe run plus 2 soil-filled planted bins. House rules (capOpenFaces, lockJoints) run, mesh clear. No seed-packet prop exists so drawers staged empty.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
